name: Elior Zalmar
title: Philosopher-Scientist (Deceased / Disputed)
summary: The architect of the Etheric Engine at Thametan's Tower. His resonance cascade caused the Great Mud Flood. Whether he died in it or stepped sideways through time is still debated.

name: Professor Harlan Moore
title: Historian
summary: Obsessed with uncovering Tartaria's secrets. Will use any means and burn any ally to get closer to lost knowledge.

name: Sasha Ironheart
title: Leader of the Tartarian Revivalists
summary: Believes reviving the Tartarian Giants is humanity's salvation. Charismatic, dangerous, willing to risk a second flood.

name: Drake Volkov
title: Mercenary
summary: Seasoned expedition guard with a murky past. Loyalty follows the coin. Has worked for every faction at least once.

name: Ivy Solis
title: Treasure Hunter
summary: Driven entirely by the value of the next find. Charming until you're competition.

name: Dr. Lucius Kincaid
title: Expedition Sponsor
summary: A reclusive financier who supplies ancient maps, gear, and TC to those willing to dig where he points. Motives unknown.

name: Old John Begotsnit
title: Merchant
summary: An old road merchant the Arbiter remembers. Keeps a fine collection of rare relics for the right buyer.
